affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 068 on October 18, 1943; the residual category names no exact profession, employer, institution, workplace, or duties.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The residual occupation code cannot identify a particular profession, employer, or later Army-to-OSS sequence.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 469 on December 14, 1942; the grouped category names no exact trade, employer, quarry, plant, product, worksite, or duties.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The grouped occupation code does not establish a named employer or the later Army-to-OSS sequence.

affiliations.date_precision: The official Army-entry record carries civilian occupation code 126 on July 7, 1943; the combined category does not establish which of its three roles applied and names no employer, payroll office, worksite, or duties.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier confirms identity. The combined category cannot support one exact role, a named employer, or the later Army-to-OSS sequence.

claims.claim_text: The indexed John D. Brown is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and fixed-width-normalized private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and numeric private identifier match after accounting for the official file's fixed-width leading zero; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by the exact full indexed name and unique numeric identifier after documented fixed-width normalization.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated November 17, 1945; the index documents an OSS personnel file but not the OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: The immediately preceding John D. Brown row carries a different private identifier. Both rows remain separate and are linked only as a possible-duplicate group for archival review; civilian occupation code 590 is withheld because its meaning was not securely established.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, John L. Brown was recorded in a residual semiprofessional occupation category.

claims.match_notes: No exact profession, employer, institution, workplace, duties, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred from the residual category.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies John R. Brown and Box 85 but no private identifier, rank, occupation, or other discriminator. Exact-name OSS, CIA, military, employment, obituary, cemetery, institutional, newspaper, directory, and archival searches did not isolate the indexed person.
person_updates.next_action: Review Box 85 for a full middle name, identifier, rank, branch, residence, occupation, employer, and service chronology before assigning any same-name veteran.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked OSS index and official Army merged file agree on John D. Brown's exact full name and numeric private identifier after accounting for the official fixed-width field's leading zero. The identifier remains withheld; the Army row dates entry to November 17, 1945. Civilian occupation code 590 is withheld because no secure meaning was established in the reviewed official list.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Compare both adjacent John D. Brown files in Box 85, establish the meaning of the Army occupation entry from the personnel file, and reconstruct the Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked OSS index and official Army merged file agree on John L. Brown's exact full name and private identifier. The identifier remains withheld; the Army row dates entry to October 18, 1943 and carries civilian occupation code 068.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 85 for the exact semiprofessional occupation, employer, and Army-to-OSS chronology.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually checked index supplies Joseph A. Brown Jr., a private identifier, and Box 85 but no rank or occupation. person_updates.next_action: Review Box 85 for rank, branch, residence, occupation, employer, and service chronology; compare recovered details with official military records.
